== Day 2: Quickly Have People Trust You ==

=== Theory ===
Being trustworthy helps you for the longevity of your relationships

Be genuinely honest

Being honest lasts long

Being honest independent of your interests

Revealing a vulnerability makes you appear more trustworthy

If you are experiencing something in silence, expressing it is useful

=== Practice ===
Using touch to achieve trust

=== Greeting touch ===
Can finally do it after COVID

Become a hugger. Simple one arm over and one under

=== Emphasis hug ===
Light push or knee tap for a joke

Other kinds of touch like this

Okay regions

* Shoulders
* Arms
* Forearms
* Knee if sitting

Rest hand for one second

=== Action guide ===
Hug someone when introducing self to someone, if I am in a meeting hug everyone

Or otherwise do a touching today

I shook hands with a classmate and the interaction went a lot better than I thought.

== Day 3: Earn Respect In Any Situation ==

=== Where are you from ===
I'm from the West Coast. Unfortunately, the area I'm from isn't that friendly, so I struggled to make many friends there. However I went on a trip to the Netherlands and made a ton there, so I'm planning on moving there this summer.

=== What do you do? ===

# What do you do?
# I write magic incantations that run much of the economy
# Really
# Yeah, I'm a programmer. It's fine and I'm good at it but it doesn't feel like I'm making enough of a difference in the world. What I love is philosophy, so I'm trying to create a unified spiritual philosophy to unite the world under.

== Day 4: Connecting Beyond Small Talk ==
Hit emotions in right order

* Initially fun
* Gain trust
* Gain respect
* Compliment people
You need genuine interest in people. Cultivate that

People often have interesting elements that you don't see at first. 

=== Action guide ===
Ask a value question. Searching for motivation rather than just facts. 

For example if they say they didn't do much in their day, ask them if they are happy about that, if so then do they plan on continuing their life this way, if not then do they plan on making changes

I tried with three people today and couldn't get to the values, but one was a cashier so that's understandable

I am Immanuelle Leonhart. I am a God and I will change the world. ❤️💚💙

I am the '''only''' person offering a better world for everyone. Other people always offer a specific vision for a specific group of people, screw all the others.
